name: Merit Wins the Soul
original_name: ความดีชนะใจ
overview: When people do good, they deserve to receive good in return. But for some, doing good for bad people might only lead to emptiness in return. This is the story of a woman who has been in a long-term relationship. She takes care of him and looks after him, even though he’s been secretly involved with other women throughout their time together. When she finds out, he apologizes and asks for another chance to start fresh, and she forgives him every time. What she doesn’t realize is that in doing good to win the hearts of others, she has forgotten to do good for her own heart.
